notes.title: Gun Crazy Is Now Available on Steam! Deathopolis is Coming to Steam in 2020!
notes.content:
Gun Crazy is a fast paced and hectic arcade style action shoot em’ up, sporting old school pixel art and a retro sound track.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066823/eb8c2ae277deb313ff6dc325a244c0757f2c5444.jpg

Tackle bosses, dodge an onslaught of bullets, and use multiple weapons to take out your foes. Hope you brought your "A" game otherwise be prepared to spam those "continues"!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/897640/Gun_Crazy/


Deathopolis is an arcade style fast paced shooter. Take on a series of rooms collecting prizes and clearing out waves of enemies using guns and power-up abilities.


     Fast paced arcade action
     Numerous boss fights
     Multiple weapons
     Lots of power ups
     Hordes of enemies



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1002820/Deathopolis/

notes.title: evious Dungeon Set For the Release On Steam August 16th!
notes.content:
Devious Dungeon Set For the Release On Steam August 16th!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33027501/3cc63affe3c1bc17ab4f6b695a0380b21089b253.jpg


Set in the Dark Ages, Devious Dungeon is a medieval focused action platformer title.

Under orders by the King, you will assume the control of a Knight instructed to head into the catacombs beneath the Kingdom, to slay the fowl beasts and monstrosities that have invaded the murky depths.
You must venture deep within the dungeons eliminating the threat!
Slay monsters, collect loot, level up and upgrade your gear.

Only a true champion will be victorious!

Features:
* Level randomization
* 5 worlds
* 68 levels
* Slay monsters and collect loot!
* Lots of weapons and gear
* RPG styled upgrades
* Boss Battles
* Mission system
